result_label: template geometry evidence; not clearance or biomechanical validation

interface_rules.foot_articulation_precedence: A foot bone gives way to each articulating foot bone before it in the segment accounting order.
interface_rules.talus_yields_to_tibia: The talus gives way to the placed tibia.
interface_rules.fibula_yields_to_tibia: The fibula gives way to the placed tibia.
interface_rules.knee_tissue_precedence: Knee tissues give way to the leg bones, then to the cartilage, then to the menisci, in that order.
interface_rules.cervical_pillar_endplane_extent: Each cervical articular pillar ends at its body endplane levels.

classes.unintended_articular_interior: Two bones meet at a joint. Real bones there are separated by articular surfaces; the template has no joint space. A common interior is a construction error.
classes.unintended_layer_interior: A tissue layer lies on a bone or on another tissue. A common interior double-counts the same space.
classes.attachment_representation: An authored ligament end or attached tissue lies at an attachment landmark inside the other field. The attachment is real anatomy; the shared volume is not. It becomes a zero-volume interface.
classes.unintended_path_interior: A ligament path passes through a bone or tissue that it does not attach to at that place.

limits: A refined witness searches two cubes around the grid witness only. It is not a global minimum.
A negative field value is a point inside both canonical fields. It is not a penetration depth.
No sampled common interior does not prove clearance. Thin overlap can lie between samples.
Field values are float32. Interfaces between differently placed frames are exact only to coordinate roundoff.
Lower-limb tissue pairs from #596 are outside this localization. The template report retains their findings.
No clinical, engineering or biological acceptance threshold is applied.
